card.name: Words leading up to "science" or knowledge
card.fires_on: Mid-sentence words where a term like "science" or "scientific" could plausibly come next, such as "foundations of", "scholarly methods", "axioms". Also scattered adjectives in disease-progression phrases like "progressive" and "severe".
